facts.fact: Official Gazette General Notice No. 985 of 2025 records the President appointing an eight-member Board of the Seychelles Bureau of Standards for three years from 1 August 2025, under section 5 of the Seychelles Bureau of Standards Act 2014 as last amended by Act 16 of 2021; the notice names no standard.

note: Board appointment notice dated 18 September 2025 (effective 1 August 2025); it states a body exists but no IT or data standard and no certification.
